label: 🌍 Geospatial Pack
description: Boundary lookups (state / country / zip / city → WKB geometry), spatial joins, geometry parsing, geohash/H3 indexing, Vincenty distance, CRS reprojection, reverse geocoding, and map-matching. Pairs with the built-in convert_coordinates, geo_distance, and the choropleth/heat modes of export_to_map.
author: DataInsightGrove

files.attribution: Census Bureau 2023 Places Gazetteer (Incorporated Places + CDPs, centroid + land area). Boundaries approximated as equal-area circles around the centroid at pack-build time.
files.description: 32,329 US Census Places (incorporated cities, towns, boroughs, villages + CDPs). Centroid + true land area from the gazetteer; geometry is an approximate equal-area circle. For pixel-accurate boundaries replace this resource with TIGER Place shapefiles.

files.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau Cartographic Boundary Files (10m), packaged by topojson/us-atlas v3
files.description: US state outlines at 1:10,000,000 scale. 56 rows (50 states + DC + 5 territories). WKB MULTIPOLYGON in EPSG:4326.

files.attribution: Census Bureau 2023 ZCTA Gazetteer (zip → centroid + land area). Boundaries approximated as equal-area circles around the centroid at pack-build time.
files.description: 33,791 US ZIP Code Tabulation Areas. Centroid + true land area from the gazetteer; geometry is an approximate equal-area circle (32-vertex polygon). Use a custom dataset if pixel-accurate boundaries matter.

files.attribution: Aggregate geometries (EU / EEA / Schengen / G7 / G20 / BRICS / USMCA / ASEAN) derived by UNIONing member-country polygons from world_countries_10m at pack-build time.
files.source: Computed locally from world_countries_10m.parquet — no external download.
files.description: Supra-national aggregates. Each row's `members_alpha3` lists the ISO-3 codes UNIONed to form the boundary. Same projection / WKB shape as world_countries_10m.

files.attribution: Aggregate geometries (EU / EEA / Schengen / G7 / G20 / BRICS / USMCA / ASEAN) derived by UNIONing member-country polygons from world_countries_110m at pack-build time.
files.source: Computed locally from world_countries_110m.parquet — no external download.
files.description: Supra-national aggregates at 110m resolution. Note that the EU/EEA/Schengen totals are slightly smaller than the 10m equivalents because Malta and Liechtenstein drop below the simplification threshold at 110m.

files.attribution: Natural Earth Admin 0 (10m), packaged by topojson/world-atlas v2, ISO codes via pycountry
files.description: World country outlines at 1:10,000,000 scale. 254 sovereign states + dependencies, including microstates (Malta, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Andorra) that 110m drops. WKB MULTIPOLYGON in EPSG:4326.

files.attribution: Natural Earth Admin 0 (110m), packaged by topojson/world-atlas v2, ISO codes via pycountry
files.description: World country outlines at 1:110,000,000 scale. 177 entities, microstates omitted. Used for world-scale renders where fast load + lean payload matter more than per-country detail. Combined with the dot-proxy logic in the choropleth renderer, missing microstates still surface as graduated symbols.
